    Twisting weight-homogeneous data by parameters (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Give t_i total weight −χ_i, or equivalently coefficient weight χ_i. The choices above, made separately in each weight, make F_j homogeneous". Conversely, data at t = 1 whose components have relative weights in the monoid C of the χ_i define polynomial families: the component of relative weight γ is multiplied by t^{coords γ}, where coords : Wt →+ (I → ℤ) sends χ_i to the i-th unit vector (twl for linear maps, twb for bilinear maps). For t in the torus this is conjugation by the diagonal scaling S_t (twb_torus, twl_torus), so twisting preserves all identities there; the twisted data are polynomial in t (IsPoly), so the identities hold for every t.
